Targets in Melee range automatically fail this roll.

Description: Roll a d12 for each of your Hope Slots in turn. If the slot is marked\, roll 2d12 and choose the higher value. If you roll less than 12\, cross out the slot. If you roll 12\, stop rolling\, clear all your HP and Stress\, and become Invincible until the end of the scene. While Invincible you’re immune to all damage and your Proficiency is doubled. At the end of the scene\, make a death move.
